name: fr-paquid-dementia-cohort
title: PAQUID cohort on brain ageing, sample of 2,561
description: A sample of 2,561 people aged 65 and over from PAQUID, a prospective cohort on functional and cerebral ageing started in 1988 in Gironde and Dordogne, south-western France: two cognitive test scores at baseline and time to dementia or to death without dementia over up to 12 years.

sources.title: PAQUID study group, Inserm and University of Bordeaux, Dartigues JF et al. (1992). The Paquid epidemiological program on brain ageing. Neuroepidemiology 11 (Suppl 1): 14-18

fields.name: time
fields.description: Years from baseline to dementia, death or censoring

fields.name: status
fields.description: Event (0 censored, 1 dementia onset, 2 death without dementia)

fields.name: DSST
fields.description: Digit Symbol Substitution Test score at baseline (attention and psychomotor speed)

fields.name: MMSE
fields.description: Mini Mental State Examination score at baseline (0 to 30)
